info.timeAllocation:
Study hour (150h)

= 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
The course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of both classical and contemporary marketing theories, as well as their practical applications. Throughout the course, students will engage with new classical and contemporary cases, exploring the interdisciplinary and cross-functional implications of business management theories, contemporary marketing management principles, and futuristic applications of marketing management theories and concepts. Upon successful completion of this course, students shall:

1. Acquire an understanding of the significance of management and marketing in various organisational settings.

2. Gain a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles that govern management and marketing.

3. Demonstrate outstanding analytic abilities that are critical for effectively tackling obstacles in business and marketing operations and reaching well-informed managerial judgements.
info.studentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all exercises, questions, assignments given by instructor(s)/ lecturer(s) in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purposes

- Promptly access to the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

Demonstrate proficiency in utilizing marketing and marketing mix components strategically.
